subject: Fix crash during TLS handshake with I/O threads (#1955)
reason: The change adds one atomic_thread_fence in ioThreadAccept (io_threads.c), which runs only when a TLS accept is offloaded to an I/O thread: trySendAcceptToIOThreads is called solely from connTLSAccept in tls.c, so on plain-TCP connections the changed code never executes.
